_note: Spanish grammar concept MCQs, CEFR-tagged. concept = matching es-* catalog slug in lib/grammar.ts. placement:true items are also seeded into the placement test (kind 'grammar'). Conjugation answers verified against the Jehle dataset. Authored for Langi.

questions.prompt: Nosotros ___ estudiantes. (We are students)
questions.explanation: ser with nosotros → somos; profession/identity uses ser.

questions.prompt: Yo ___ cansado hoy. (I am tired today)
questions.explanation: A temporary state uses estar → estoy.

questions.prompt: Yo ___ dos hermanos. (I have two brothers)
questions.explanation: tener with yo → tengo.

questions.prompt: Ella ___ hambre. (She is hungry)
questions.explanation: tener with ella → tiene; 'tener hambre' = to be hungry.

questions.prompt: ___ manzana es roja. (The apple, feminine)
questions.explanation: manzana is feminine singular → la.

questions.prompt: Quiero ___ café. (a coffee, masculine)
questions.explanation: Indefinite masculine singular → un.

questions.prompt: What is the plural of « el lápiz »?
questions.explanation: Words ending in -z change z→c and add -es: lápiz → lápices.

questions.prompt: Which noun is feminine?
questions.explanation: « una mesa » uses the feminine article una.

questions.prompt: Vosotros ___ inglés. (You all speak English)
questions.explanation: Regular -ar verb with vosotros → -áis (habláis).

questions.prompt: Ella ___ en Madrid. (She works in Madrid)
questions.explanation: Regular -ar verb with ella → -a (trabaja).

questions.prompt: Make it negative: « Fumo. » →
questions.explanation: Negation places no directly before the verb.

questions.prompt: Which correctly asks “Do you speak Spanish?”
questions.explanation: A yes/no question can be the statement with question intonation/marks: ¿Hablas español?

questions.prompt: ___ hermana es simpática. (My sister)
questions.explanation: Singular possessive → mi.

questions.prompt: ___ padres viven aquí. (My parents)
questions.explanation: Plural possessive → mis.

questions.prompt: Nosotros ___ en Madrid. (We live in Madrid)
questions.explanation: Regular -ir verb with nosotros → -imos (vivimos).

questions.prompt: Yo ___ pan por la mañana. (I eat bread)
questions.explanation: Regular -er verb with yo → -o (como).

questions.prompt: Ayer ___ con María. (Yesterday I spoke with María)
questions.explanation: Preterite, completed action: hablar/yo → hablé.

questions.prompt: Ellos ___ al cine anoche. (They went to the cinema)
questions.explanation: Preterite of ir (= ser) with ellos → fueron.

questions.prompt: Cuando era niño, ___ mucho. (I used to play a lot)
questions.explanation: Imperfect for a past habit: jugar/yo → jugaba.

questions.prompt: Antes nosotros ___ juntos. (we used to eat together)
questions.explanation: Imperfect of comer with nosotros → comíamos.

questions.prompt: Yo ___ comido demasiado. (I have eaten too much)
questions.explanation: Present perfect: haber (yo → he) + participle.

questions.prompt: Hemos ___ esa película. (seen — ver)
questions.explanation: Irregular past participle of ver → visto.

questions.prompt: Mañana ___ a estudiar. (I am going to study)
questions.explanation: Near future: ir (yo → voy) + a + infinitive.

questions.prompt: ___ Ana. (My name is Ana)
questions.explanation: Reflexive llamarse with yo → me llamo.

questions.prompt: Ella es ___ alta ___ yo. (taller than me)
questions.explanation: Superiority comparison → más … que.

questions.prompt: A mí ___ los libros. (I like books)
questions.explanation: gustar agrees with the thing liked; plural → gustan.

questions.prompt: ___ el café por la mañana. (I like coffee)
questions.explanation: Singular thing → me gusta.

questions.prompt: Mañana ___ con el jefe. (I will speak)
questions.explanation: Simple future of hablar with yo → hablaré.

questions.prompt: Nosotros ___ tiempo el sábado. (we will have time)
questions.explanation: Future of tener uses the irregular stem tendr- → tendremos.

questions.prompt: ___ un café, por favor. (I would like)
questions.explanation: Conditional for politeness → me gustaría.

questions.prompt: Yo ___ más si pudiera. (I would travel more)
questions.explanation: Conditional of viajar with yo → viajaría.

questions.prompt: Quiero que ___ conmigo. (I want you to talk with me)
questions.explanation: Subjunctive after querer que: hablar/tú → hables.

questions.prompt: Es importante que ___ bien. (that you eat well)
questions.explanation: Subjunctive after es importante que: comer/tú → comas.

questions.prompt: Este regalo es ___ ti. (for you)
questions.explanation: Recipient/goal → para.

questions.prompt: Gracias ___ tu ayuda. (for your help)
questions.explanation: Cause/reason and 'thanks for' → por.

questions.prompt: ¿Ves el coche? — Sí, ___ veo. (I see it)
questions.explanation: Masculine singular direct object → lo.

questions.prompt: ___ doy el libro a ella. (I give the book to her)
questions.explanation: Indirect object (to her) → le.

questions.prompt: Ya ___ comido cuando llegaste. (I had already eaten)
questions.explanation: Pluperfect: haber in the imperfect (había) + participle.

questions.prompt: ¡___ la puerta! (Close — tú command of cerrar)
questions.explanation: Affirmative tú command of cerrar → cierra.

questions.prompt: No creo que ___ verdad. (I don't think it's true)
questions.explanation: Doubt/denial triggers the subjunctive → sea.

questions.prompt: Cuando ___ a casa, te llamaré. (When I get home — future reference)
questions.explanation: cuando + future reference takes the subjunctive → llegue.

questions.prompt: La casa ___ construida en 1990. (was built)
questions.explanation: Passive with ser in the preterite → fue construida.

questions.prompt: Aquí se ___ español. (Spanish is spoken here)
questions.explanation: Impersonal/passive se + 3rd-person singular → se habla.

questions.prompt: Si hubiera estudiado, ___ aprobado. (I would have passed)
questions.explanation: Conditional perfect: habría + participle.

questions.prompt: Dijo: « Estoy cansado. » → Dijo que ___ cansado.
questions.explanation: Reported speech shifts present → imperfect: estaba.

questions.prompt: Las cartas fueron ___. (written — escribir, agreeing)
questions.explanation: In the ser-passive the participle agrees: feminine plural → escritas.

questions.prompt: Te lo explico para que lo ___. (so that you know it)
questions.explanation: para que always takes the subjunctive → sepas.

questions.prompt: Si yo ___ rico, viajaría por el mundo. (If I were rich)
questions.explanation: Hypothetical si-clause takes the imperfect subjunctive → fuera.

questions.prompt: Quería que ___ conmigo. (I wanted you to come)
questions.explanation: A past main verb requires the imperfect subjunctive → vinieras.

questions.prompt: La chica ___ madre es médica vive aquí. (whose mother)
questions.explanation: Possessive relative agreeing with madre (f.) → cuya.

questions.prompt: ___ dos horas estudiando. (I have been studying for two hours)
questions.explanation: Duration periphrasis llevar + gerund → llevo … estudiando.

questions.prompt: Lo intenté; ___, no funcionó. (nevertheless)
questions.explanation: Concessive connector ‘nevertheless’ → no obstante.

questions.prompt: Si lo ___ sabido, te lo habría dicho. (had I known)
questions.explanation: Pluperfect subjunctive in the si-clause → hubiera (or hubiese) sabido.

questions.prompt: Fue María ___ lo dijo. (It was María who said it)
questions.explanation: Cleft sentence about a person → quien (or la que).

questions.prompt: In voseo, « tú tienes » becomes…
questions.explanation: Río de la Plata voseo: vos tenés.

questions.prompt: Nominalise the verb « decidir ». →
questions.explanation: The noun from decidir is la decisión.

questions.prompt: Pase lo que ___, no me rendiré. (come what may)
questions.explanation: Fixed reduplicated subjunctive ‘pase lo que pase’.
